Keep them in a separate virtual environment each and switch per protocol.Method A: Command PaletteOpen the Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P / Ctrl+Shift+P)Select Extensions: Install from VSIX...Choose the downloaded .vsix fileMethod B: Command linecode --install-extension protocol-visualizer.vsix
